title: Red Dead Online: Strange Tales of the West Vol. 1

features.desc: Theodore Levin telegram missions launched from camp lockbox/post office.
Strange Tales of the Plague: retrieve infected corpses while fighting undead and cultists in Armadillo.
Strange Tales of Modern Science: investigate and destroy rogue automatons near Braithwaite Manor.
Strange Tales of the Bayou: hunt swamp creature in Lagras amid hostile swamp-folk ambushes.
Strange Tales of the Wilderness: track missing scientist in Tall Trees with survival/crafting pressure.
Anthology framing device and collectible lore entries.
Gold/RDO$/XP multipliers hooks and role progression rewards.
